Line.DefaultText:
He's interested in animals, their yield and feed. 
Favours partridges and their eggs. 
Usually brings chicken, cows, pigs, cheese, eggs and animal feed.
Line.Text: 他对动物、产出和饲料感兴趣。\n偏爱灰山鹑及其蛋。\n通常会带来鸡、牛、猪、奶酪、蛋和动物饲料。
Line.zh: 他对动物、产出和饲料感兴趣。\n偏爱灰山鹑及其蛋。\n通常会带来鸡、牛、猪、奶酪、蛋和动物饲料。
Line.en: He's interested in animals, their yield and feed. \nFavours partridges and their eggs. \nUsually brings chicken, cows, pigs, cheese, eggs and animal feed.
Line.ja:
He's interested in animals, their yield and feed.

Line.DefaultText:
He takes a moment before answering and says he's a trader specialized on animals and their yield. 
He doesn't seem to be that good at making conversation.
Line.Text: 他停顿片刻后回答，说自己是专营动物及其产出的商人。\n看起来他并不擅长闲聊。
Line.zh: 他停顿片刻后回答，说自己是专营动物及其产出的商人。\n看起来他并不擅长闲聊。

Line.DefaultText: He says he will try to bring additional cheese on his next visit.
Line.Text: 他说下次来的时候会试着带些额外的奶酪。
Line.zh: 他说下次来的时候会试着带些额外的奶酪。
Line.en: He says he will try to bring additional cheese on his next visit.
Line.ja: He says he will try to bring additional cheese on his next visit.

Line.DefaultText: He says he will bring more Chickens on his next visit.
Line.Text: 他说下次来的时候会带更多的鸡。
Line.zh: 他说下次来的时候会带更多的鸡。
Line.en: He says he will bring more Chickens on his next visit.
